title: olearia microphylla
intro: Olearia microphylla, commonly known as the New Zealand tawari or mountain tawari, is a small to medium-sized shrub native to New Zealand. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Olearia microphylla include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may contribute to its traditional use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Olearia microphylla include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
